channel.title: The Margin Wars | The Rulebook Wire / AU & NZ [Preview]
channel.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review — official sources, practical moves.

item.title: NZ moves on commercial cards
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The 22 October decision introduces commercial credit-card interchange limits on Mastercard and Visa. Who: New Zealand merchants and acquirers. Effective: 2027-04-22. Official source: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/projects/interchange-fee-regulation/

item.title: Scheme fees come into view
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. First quarterly aggregate fee publications by designated card networks were due for the July–September period. Who: Card networks; acquiring teams. Effective: 2026-10-30. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Acquirer fee disclosures begin
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Qualifying large acquirers must publish merchant service fee data by merchant size and card type. Who: Large acquirers and merchants. Effective: 2026-10-30. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Australia: card surcharge reset
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. eftpos, Mastercard and Visa no-surcharge rules apply from 1 October after the RBA removed its prohibition on those rules. Who: Australian merchants and acquirers. Effective: 2026-10-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/faqs/index.html

item.title: Domestic interchange: lower caps
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Revised interchange regulation applies to domestic-issued card transactions acquired in Australia. Who: Australian acquirers and issuers. Effective: 2026-10-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Issuer compensation rules change
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The amended net-compensation regime starts, with transitional arrangements for 2026/27. Who: Card networks and issuers. Effective: 2026-10-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Next: prove interchange pass-through
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. First publication of large acquirers’ interchange pass-through measures covers October–December 2026. Who: Large acquirers and merchant finance teams. Effective: 2027-01-30. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Foreign-issued cards get a cap
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Interchange caps extend to foreign-issued card transactions acquired in Australia. Who: Cross-border acquiring teams. Effective: 2027-04-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Merchant statements get sharper
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. More statement detail is required from the first full statement period starting on or after 1 April. Who: Australian acquirers and merchants. Effective: 2027-04-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Scheme-fee roadmap expected
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The RBA expects a scheme-fee roadmap by 1 April; this is an expectation, not a new fee cap. Who: Card networks and acquiring teams. Effective: 2027-04-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html
